verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents its own programmatic KYC path: a Customer API that accepts KYC data captured in your own screens. It also documents a self-driving challenge frame that runs the required verification steps before a buy proceeds. Business (KYB) verification and recipient clearance for sending and receiving are not evidenced, and endpoint-level KYC documentation is thin. Missing for 10: documented KYB endpoints for business counterparties, recipient/beneficiary onboarding, KYC status/approval endpoints or webhooks that gate money movement, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, customer and recipient onboarding is programmatic — documented KYC/KYB endpoints or flows that clear a counterparty for sending and receiving before money moves

citations.quote: The API-driven path: capture KYC data in your own screens and submit it with the Customer API.
the challenge frame is self-driving — after initialization, it sequences through all required verification steps and emits `complete` when the pipeline finishes.
MoonPay runs the KYC, payments, and UI.
